Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Head of Asset Lifecycle Planning who will own the solution domain that turns Geotab's telematics and cost data into prescriptive fleet capital decisions — enabling customers to operate the right-sized, right-aged, and right-deployed set of assets at the lowest total cost of ownership. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Head of Asset Lifecycle Planning, your key area of responsibility will be owning the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Asset Lifecycle Planning domain — spanning replacement and retirement planning, right-sizing, reallocation, utilization-driven capital recommendations, total cost of ownership analytics, and EV adoption strategy. You will be responsible for translating board-level strategic direction into product execution and ensuring confident, defensible capital decisions are made inside the product. You will need to work closely with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, and product engineers, as well as partner closely with the Maintenance domain, platform teams, segment leads, and executive leadership.

To be successful in this role you will be a customer-obsessed, strategic leader with strong commercial instinct and the ability to connect customer pain to market opportunity and business value. In addition, the successful candidate will have deep cross-functional leadership experience across product management, design, and engineering disciplines, with the ability to operate at the intersection of business strategy, customer experience, and technical execution — owning outcomes while building and developing high-performing teams.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Asset Lifecycle Planning domain, ensuring confident, data-driven capital decisions (keep, replace, remove, reallocate, or buy) are made inside the product in minutes rather than weeks.
  • Lead the identification and resolution of product gaps, competitive risks, and market opportunities, maintaining a customer-demand-driven roadmap prioritized by impact to fleet outcomes and business KPAs.
  • Build, develop, and lead a cross-functional team of product managers, designers, and product engineers; provide coaching, mentorship, and career development to grow next-generation talent and emerging leaders.
  • Own the Asset Lifecycle Planning domain investment portfolio; make principled build/buy/partner decisions and trade-offs between new capability development, growth, customer satisfaction, and quality.
  • Partner with Heads of Platform Domain, Segment Domain, and peer Solution Domain leads to coordinate cross-cutting dependencies and ensure Asset Lifecycle Planning capabilities are packaged and positioned effectively for key customer segments.
  • Track and report on business outcomes, customer KPA attainment, and domain delivery health — including adoption, revenue, churn, and NPS — surfacing risks and recommendations to board leadership.
  • Establish feedback loops with customers, sales, and support teams to continuously capture product gaps and translate them into actionable improvements that drive fleet capital efficiency.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 5+ years in product management, product engineering, or related customer-facing product roles, with 5+ years of senior product and people leadership with cross-functional scope and direct accountability for customer-facing business outcomes.
  • Strong product leadership capability with demonstrated ability to define and execute customer-facing product strategy tied to measurable business outcomes, with P&L literacy and revenue attribution.
  • Deep customer empathy and commercial instinct — proven ability to connect customer pain to market opportunity, product investment, and business value.
  • Cross-functional leadership experience across product management, product design, and product engineering disciplines, with the ability to operate at the intersection of business strategy, customer experience, and technical execution.
  • Proficient in defining and tracking product KPIs, customer adoption metrics, and outcome-linked business indicators; familiarity with modern product discovery and validation practices.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to build effective partnerships with platform teams, segment leads, and executive leadership in evolving, ambiguous organizational structures.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience); relevant product management certifications (e.g., PSPO, CPO) considered an asset.

Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
 
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram. 

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Head of Tax & Asset Compliance who will own the solution domain that helps North American fleets meet their tax and asset compliance obligations while protecting profitability. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Head of Tax & Asset Compliance your key area of responsibility will be turning Geotab's telematics data into compliance outcomes (automated evidence, filings, and monitoring) that minimize compliance violations, fines, downtime, and administrative burden. You will need to work closely with the Tech Dev Board, Heads of Platform Domain, Heads of Segment Domain, peer Heads of Solution Domain, cross-functional domain teams (product managers, designers, product engineers), and external fleet customers.

To be successful in this role you will be a strategic leader with deep customer empathy, high adaptability, change readiness, and strong stakeholder management and communication skills. In addition, the successful candidate will have P&L literacy, commercial instinct, expertise in defining and tracking product KPIs, and the ability to operate at the intersection of business strategy, customer experience, and technical execution. 

How you'll make an impact:

  • Product Strategy & Vision: Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the domain, driving build/buy/partner decisions and evaluating emerging customer needs to strengthen market differentiation.

  • Business & Metric Ownership: Accountable for primary business KPAs (e.g., submission success rates, violations avoided) and driving adoption of compliance workflows.

  • Customer Value Delivery: Serve fleet operators, compliance managers, and asset owners as primary customers, defining and measuring experience metrics (adoption, time-to-value, NPS).

  • Cross-Segment Alignment: Partner with Heads of Segment Domain to ensure tax and asset compliance capabilities are packaged and positioned effectively for key market segments.

  • Feedback Loops & Experience Quality: Establish strong feedback loops with customers, sales, and support to resolve product gaps while owning UX quality standards across all domain surfaces.

  • People Leadership & Coaching: Provide mentoring, career development, and performance management to cross-functional teams, identifying and coaching high-potential, next-generation leaders.

  • Culture & Capacity Management: Foster a high-trust, high-accountability team culture focused on customer obsession and rapid iteration while managing team capacity across discovery and delivery.

  • Financial Stewardship & Investment: Own the domain investment portfolio, leading annual planning for budget, headcount, and OKRs while balancing growth, quality, and capability bets.

  • Executive & Board Reporting: Translate board-level direction into execution plans and regularly report on domain outcomes, revenue contributions, and delivery health to executive leadership.

  • Cross-Domain & Platform Collaboration: Partner with Heads of Platform Domain to leverage shared infrastructure/APIs and coordinate with peer solution domains to eliminate duplication.

  • Community & Strategic Leadership: Participate in practitioner communities (Engineering, Product, Design) and lead board-appointed, cross-functional initiatives across domains.

  • Organizational Strategic Alignment: Support company-wide strategic initiatives, including AI workflow adoption, security posture, accessibility, and compliance programs

What you'll bring to this role:

  • 10+ years of experience in product management, product engineering, or related customer-facing product roles.

  • 5+ years of senior product and people leadership with cross-functional scope and direct accountability for customer-facing business outcomes.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).

  • Strong product leadership capability with demonstrated ability to define and execute customer-facing product strategy tied to measurable business outcomes, with P&L literacy and revenue attribution.

  • Cross-functional leadership experience managing teams across product management, product design, and product engineering disciplines, with proven capability in identifying and coaching high-potential leaders.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, change readiness, and communication skills to effectively collaborate with platform teams, segment leads, and executive leadership in evolving organizational structures.

  • Familiarity with modern product discovery, validation practices, and engineering practices (CI/CD, cloud-native delivery, agile), alongside the ability to redesign domain workflows around AI to compress effort.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Head of Transportation & Logistics who will own the end-to-end commercial success of Geotab's Transportation & Logistics market segment — accountable for segment revenue attainment and growth, product and go-to-market strategy across one of Geotab's largest and most strategically significant market segments, encompassing commercial fleet operators, truckload carriers, freight and logistics companies, and private fleets across North America. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Head of Transportation & Logistics your key area of responsibility will be developing and executing the product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market to enable successful commercial execution for the T&L segment. You will be responsible for owning the segment's revenue attainment and growth, making principled build/buy/partner decisions, identifying gaps in Geotab's current solutions for the segment, and defining packaging, pricing, and positioning strategies that make Geotab's capabilities compelling for T&L buyers across fleet size tiers — from large enterprise fleets to mid-market carriers and small fleet operators. You will need to work closely with Geotab's solution domain leads, platform domain leads, peer segment leads, sales, marketing, engineering, and channel partners.

To be successful in this role you will be a strategic leader with deep commercial acumen, strong executive presence, and the ability to operate with clarity at the intersection of market strategy, customer experience, and product capability. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong analytical and business performance skills with an ability to define and drive segment-specific revenue metrics, manage cross-functional teams, and translate board-level strategic direction into a coherent go-to-market execution plan with measurable results.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and go-to-market to enable successful commercial execution for the T&L segment; accountable for the segment's primary business KPA including revenue attainment and segment growth.
  • Develop deep understanding of T&L customers — including truckload carriers, private fleet operators, logistics companies, and owner-operators — building and maintaining relationships with key customers, industry bodies, and channel partners.
  • Oversee the hiring, onboarding, development, and performance management of a cross-functional T&L segment team including segment specialists, product leads, designers, and engineers.
  • Translate board-level strategic direction into a coherent T&L segment go-to-market plan and execution roadmap; operate as the commercial owner of the segment's outcomes, including investment portfolio management within approved parameters.
  • Define and measure segment-specific success metrics including revenue attainment, market share, win rate, and customer retention as primary success indicators.
  • Partner with solution and platform domain leads to identify capability gaps for the T&L segment, collaborate on segment-specific product requirements, and leverage Geotab's existing platform and solution building blocks.
  • Own T&L segment-specific compliance, regulatory, and certification requirements — including ELD mandate, FMCSA, CARB, and CSA standards — that affect Geotab's market access and competitive positioning.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 10+ years of experience in a segment-focused commercial, product, or go-to-market role within the transportation, logistics, or fleet telematics industry.
  • 5+ years in senior leadership roles with cross-functional commercial or product scope within a carrier, fleet operator, telematics provider, or freight technology company, including 3+ years with direct accountability for revenue or commercial outcomes within the T&L market.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience managing cross-functional teams or senior commercial and product leads.
  • Deep knowledge of the Transportation & Logistics market including commercial fleet operations, truckload carrier industry dynamics, freight market trends, regulatory environment (ELD mandate, FMCSA, CARB, CSA, DOT), and competitive dynamics within the fleet telematics industry.
  • Strong commercial and go-to-market acumen — ability to define packaging, pricing, and positioning strategies that drive T&L segment revenue and market share across enterprise, mid-market, and SMB fleet operators.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to build effective partnerships with solution teams, platform teams, channel partners, and executive leadership.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be substituted.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Lead Software Developer who will be primarily responsible for designing, building and maintaining efficient, reusable, reliable code to develop high throughput, performance critical, scalable applications. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you! 

What you'll do:

As a Lead Software Developer your key area of responsibility will be designing, building and maintaining efficient, reusable, reliable code to develop high throughput, performance critical, scalable applications. You will be responsible for leading the development of scalable code, prototypes, and PoCs, taking ownership of complex, long-term projects, and ensuring timely delivery. You will need to work closely with other software developers, engineers, internal technical teams, cross-functional partners, product managers, and external stakeholders.

To be successful in this role you will be a strong team-player and mentor with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable working under pressure in a flat organization, and possessing excellent verbal and written communication skills to document complex technical systems. In addition, the successful candidate will have expert technical competence in design and architecture, exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, and strong project management capabilities to manage multiple fast-changing priorities simultaneously. 

How you'll make an impact:

  • Independently and proactively identify key areas of architecture improvement, including preparing proposals on achieving the improvements.

  • Lead, oversee and plan the development of scalable code, prototypes, minimum viable products and PoCs.

  • Take ownership of complex/ long-term projects and contribute to their implementation, including defining scope, requirements, communicating project progress, challenges and solutions, while ensuring timely delivery.

  • Collaborate with other development teams on design and implementation of features spanning multiple products.

  • Conduct comprehensive testing and code reviews to ensure that code quality is maximized and best-practices are followed.

  • Provide expert project-leadership and guidance as a SME, to the department and larger organization.

  • Contributes to defining strategic direction, planning the roadmap, and synthesizing feedback to ensure team success.

  • Serve as a cross functional resource across team/department and products to contribute to solving technical issues in development.

  • Builds relationships and serve as a technical point of contact partnering with stakeholders including customers, product managers, cross-functional partners, and external partners and other internal team members.

  • Mentor other developers on the team and work with the team leads to set the direction of the team and guide key stakeholders on execution choices and trade-offs, and advise manager with insights and recommendations to improve the team.

  • Appropriately document system design and architecture such that it is easy to understand, maintain and extend.

  • Support Geotab global strategic initiatives.

  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotating schedule (if applicable).

  • Independently evaluate technical solutions, while contributing to the team roadmap.

  • Present and lead technical discussions and training at the department wide level.

  • Stay up to date on emerging technologies and changes in best practices in the development field and present them to senior leadership for consideration.

  • Write complex scalable, high quality and secure software in a variety of programming languages and environments, such as C#, JavaScript, SQL.

  • Serve as a domain expert (ex GBQ), consulting in the area of expertise for the department and across the organization.

What you'll bring to this role

  • 10 - 12 years of experience as a Software Developer using object-oriented programming to build scalable applications.

  • Post-secondary Diploma/Degree with specialization in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent working experience.

  • Proven technical expertise in design, architecture, and optimizing databases (e.g., MySQL), with hands-on experience using Python, Google Compute Engine, and Google BigQuery.

  • Strong database proficiency with SQL Server and Postgres database design, optimization, and query writing.

  • Deep frontend knowledge encompassing languages and libraries (HTML/CSS, JavaScript, XML, ES6, jQuery), JavaScript frameworks (Angular, React, Node.js, Vue.js), and UI/UX design.

  • Proficiency in Git or other distributed source control tools, including resolving merge conflicts and managing branches.

  • Demonstrated leadership success in the mentorship and development of employees, including serving as a mentor for interns over several years.

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, research open-ended design problems, and work effectively under pressure.

    • Complete minor adjustments and repairs to building equipment, systems, fixtures, and infrastructure.

    • Travel to satellite offices, including Waterloo and Toronto, to perform maintenance, inspections, and minor repairs.

    • Support scheduling of ongoing, emergency, and preventive building maintenance activities.

    • Coordinate with external vendors and property management for facility maintenance, repairs, and service delivery.

    • Set up, arrange, relocate, or remove furniture and decorations to support office moves, events, and workspace changes.

    • Respond to facility emergencies and urgent maintenance requests during and outside business hours.

    • High school diploma or equivalent experience.

    • One to three years of experience in janitorial services, building maintenance, facilities coordination, or a related field.

    • Working knowledge of building maintenance procedures, cleaning equipment, products, techniques, and safe operating practices.

    • Ability to perform minor repairs to building systems, fixtures, and equipment.

    • Strong organization, prioritization, communication, problem-solving, and service-oriented teamwork skills.

    • Valid driver's license for travel between office locations and Pool Car program support.

    • Trade certifications or WHMIS training are assets; willingness to provide on-call and after-hours support as needed.

If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Manager, Deal Desk your key area of responsibility will be overseeing a team of deal desk professionals responsible for reviewing and approving non-standard pricing requests, reseller RFPs, credit requests, and commercial agreement structuring, ensuring the deal desk operates with clear SLAs, consistent pricing governance, and a strong commercial framework that supports sales velocity while protecting margin. You will need to work closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Legal, and Finance. To be successful in this role you will be a strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen and an entrepreneurial mindset.

Define and enforce deal desk SLAs, triage standards, and approval thresholds to ensure consistent, timely resolution of all inbound requests. Serve as the primary escalation point for complex commercial scenarios requiring senior-level judgment. Establish and maintain a deal desk approval framework that enables appropriate delegation to team members while preserving commercial controls.
  • Commercial Execution: Lead commercial negotiations with Sales, Resellers, and direct customers to finalize non-standard pricing agreements, amendments, and deal structures. Administer and govern commercial pricing in DealHub CPQ, including playbook design, approval workflow configuration, and quoting rule management. Collaborate with Revenue Operations to ensure deal structures are operationally executable and compliant with established commercial policies. Partner with Finance and Legal on deal terms that carry contractual or margin risk.
  • People Leadership: Oversee the activities, development and performance of direct reports across the Deal Desk pillar. Provide direction, coaching and mentorship to the team. Engage in the development of the team by coaching, providing feedback, identifying areas of growth and training opportunities. Collaborate and support employees during the performance management process, meeting KPAs and career development planning. Support Geotab global strategic initiatives. Manage team budget and headcount within approved parameters, contributing to annual planning and resource allocation for the Deal Desk pillar.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 5 - 8 years of required previous experience in a deal desk, commercial pricing, or similar commercial role in a B2B SaaS or technology environment.  
  • 1 - 3 years of required supervisory experience managing a deal desk, pricing, or commercial operations team, with demonstrated ability to coach and hold a team accountable to SLAs. 
  • Strong commercial acumen with demonstrated experience negotiating pricing and structuring complex deals. 
  • Deep understanding of deal desk operations including approval frameworks, SLA management, and commercial risk assessment.
  • Experience with CPQ or deal management platforms; DealHub experience valued.
  • Experience designing and implementing deal desk intake processes, approval workflows, and escalation frameworks.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage high-volume queues alongside strategic initiatives simultaneously.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation skills.
  • Strategic mindset with a keen sense of commercial priorities and the ability to make sound decisions under time pressure.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Legal.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfortable in a flat organization.
  • Comfort working with data and analytical tools to inform deal desk decisions; ability to build and interpret reports, dashboards, and commercial performance metrics using spreadsheet tools or BI platforms.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Manager, Product Marketing who will lead a team of market facing experts to drive the growth and adoption of your product portfolio. You will be a key contributor to the product strategy and roadmap, responsible for developing compelling positioning and messaging. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Manager, Product Marketing, you will own the go-to-market strategy, leading cross-functional teams to ensure successful product launches and campaigns. You will mentor your team, foster a culture of market expertise, and serve as a strategic partner to Product, Sales, and Marketing leadership, ultimately owning the market success of your products.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Lead and mentor the team to tell the product story in a simple, clear, and compelling way, ensuring consistent and differentiated messaging that effectively shares Geotab’s products with the world. Oversee the development and refinement of product positioning and messaging frameworks.

  • Partner with Product Marketing Management (PMM) leadership and other senior team members to guide the team in building the holistic product marketing roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities. Establish and track Key Performance Areas (KPAs) for the team and contribute to defining overall team goals year over year. Develop and champion strategies to achieve the next level of growth through team efforts.

  • Partner with Product Marketing Management (PMM) leadership to actively shape and advance the Product Marketing craft at Geotab. Lead the development and implementation of scalable processes and standards for how the team goes to market and coordinates with internal stakeholders. Oversee the evaluation and management of 3rd party tools or platforms to enhance the capabilities and efficiency of the PMM function.

  • Ensure the team collaborates closely with Product Managers to embody the "voice" of their respective products, possessing comprehensive knowledge of features and capabilities. Guide the team in tailoring messaging and documentation to meet the specific requirements of individual and sales teams.

  • Foster and lead strong collaborative relationships with Product Managers, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing teams to ensure alignment and seamless execution of product marketing strategies driven by your team. Represent the Product Marketing team in cross-functional leadership discussions.

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement leadership to define priorities and oversee the team's creation and delivery of effective training programs and sales tools, equipping the sales team with the knowledge and resources they need to effectively sell the product.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Product Marketing Managers, fostering a collaborative and engaged environment. Provide coaching, mentorship, and ongoing feedback while supporting talent management, performance management, resource planning, and professional development. Oversee performance reviews and related HR activities, and continuously improve team processes, policies, and ways of working.

  • Drive the advancement of product, sales, and marketing KPAs by guiding the team's creation of impactful product marketing deliverables (messaging and content). Ensure the team is focused on successful adoption of features and functionality of new releases. Monitor and report on pipeline and lead generation goals in partnership with marketing teams, holding the team accountable for results.

What you'll bring to this role:

  • 10+ years  of work experience ideally in Product Marketing in SaaS.

  • 3–5 years in a supervisory role.

  • Post-Secondary Diploma/Degree specialization in Engineering, Business/Marketing, Computer Science or a related field highly valued.

  • Ability to analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes. 

  • Solid understanding of product development and marketing principles.    

  • Experience in developing sales tools and training programs.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.

  • Deep understanding of customer needs and the ability to translate those needs into compelling product marketing strategies.

  • Experience coaching, managing and developing team members.    

  • Ability to establish and optimize product marketing processes and standards. 

  • Innovative thinker with a knack for developing unique marketing campaigns and strategies.

  • Deep understanding of customer needs and motivations.    

  • Expertise in conducting in-depth competitive analysis and developing strategies to differentiate products.    

  • Strong ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including customers, partners, and industry influencers.

If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Pilot Success Manager your key area of responsibility is be the primary driver ensuring that prospective and existing customers experience the full value of the company’s ecosystem, from core telematics solutions to the newest product innovations. By demonstrating tangible ROI and aligning technology with the customer's business objectives, this role plays a pivotal role in securing new business and driving significant account expansion.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Lead and manage the entire lifecycle of strategic customer pilots for both new business prospects and existing customer expansion opportunities.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to key customer stakeholders. Use pilot data and insights to proactively address concerns, overcome objections, and influence their evaluation criteria to align with Geotab's unique value proposition.

  • Partner with the Business Development Manager during the pilot planning phase to define a strategic approach that directly maps to the prospect's primary business challenges and desired outcomes, ensuring a targeted and impactful evaluation.

  • Collaborate closely with the Sales team, Solutions Engineering, and key customer stakeholders to define clear pilot objectives, success criteria, and key performance indicators (KPIs) that align with the customer's business goals.

  • Develop and execute detailed pilot project plans, including timelines, resource allocation, communication cadences, and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Act as the primary point of contact during the pilot phase, guiding customers through hardware installation, platform configuration, and user training to ensure rapid adoption and value realization.

  • Monitor pilot progress, analyze telematics data, and generate insightful reports. Proactively identify and present findings that demonstrate the value and ROI of Geotab's solutions in the customer's real-world environment.

  •  Serve as the central liaison between the customer and internal Geotab teams, including Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Product Management, to ensure a seamless and supportive pilot experience.

  • Expertly manage pilots for Geotab's emerging products and features (e.g., EV solutions, ADAS, new Marketplace integrations), providing critical early-stage feedback to the Product team.

  • Act as one of the first lines of support for any technical challenges during the pilot, effectively triaging issues and coordinating with Solutions Engineering and technical support teams for swift resolution.

  • Prepare and deliver compelling final pilot summary presentations to customer executives, translating technical outcomes into tangible business benefits and providing a clear recommendation for moving forward.

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, or Customer Success Management.

  • The ability to quickly grasp a customer's business model, identify their key financial and operational drivers, and articulate how our solutions create tangible business value.

  • Proven experience in a B2B SaaS environment, managing complex projects or technical deployments for large enterprise or strategic accounts.

  • Skilled in applying a consultative, solution-selling methodology to align technology with customer business objectives.

  • Strong project management skills with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously.

  • Strong technical acumen and the ability to quickly learn and articulate complex hardware and software solutions.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently engage with a wide range of stakeholders, from fleet managers to C-level executives.

  • Data-driven and analytical mindset; comfortable working with data to uncover trends and prove value.

  • Experience managing Proof of Concepts (PoCs) or technical trials in a pre-sales capacity.

  • A proactive, problem-solving attitude with a relentless focus on customer success and achieving objectives.

  • Ability to travel occasionally to customer sites across North America.

  • Direct experience in the telematics, fleet management, logistics, or IoT industries is a nice to have.

  • Spanish or Brazilian Portuguese considered an asset.

Geotab is seeking an Enablement Lead who will be responsible for defining and driving sales and partner readiness strategy across a specific product, platform, or segment domain — equipping the field with the positioning, sales plays, and execution frameworks needed to sell and scale solutions globally. If you love translating complex capabilities into compelling field strategies and thrive at the intersection of product, go-to-market, and revenue execution, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you’ll do:

As an Enablement Lead, your key area of responsibility will be owning and defining the end-to-end enablement strategy for a specific product, platform, or segment domain, ensuring all solutions are grounded in deep domain expertise and directly tied to field execution. You will be responsible for translating product and solution capabilities into domain-specific value propositions, sales plays, deal strategies, and scalable execution frameworks that span the full revenue lifecycle — from prospecting and discovery through proposal and expansion. You will also need to define and own a suite of enablement assets including sales playbooks, messaging frameworks, competitive positioning guides, objection handling frameworks, demo strategies, and discovery guides, all built to reflect real-world customer scenarios and sales motions within your domain.

You will need to work closely with Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales Leadership, Revenue Delivery, and Revenue Operations to ensure enablement is tightly aligned to roadmap, GTM priorities, and field performance outcomes, while also collaborating with central teams including Learning Design, Content, and Demo Excellence to operationalize and deliver programs at scale. To be successful in this role you will be a strategic thinker who balances big-picture vision with execution-focused outcomes and thrives in cross-functional environments. In addition, the successful candidate will have deep understanding of solution selling, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to communicate complex domain concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

How you’ll make an impact:

• Own and define the enablement strategy for a specific product, platform, or segment domain, ensuring all enablement solutions are grounded in deep expertise within that specific area

• Act as the primary enablement partner to Sales leadership, aligning on priorities, pipeline needs, and performance outcomes

• Ensure readiness across the full revenue lifecycle, including prospecting, qualification, discovery, demo, proposal, and expansion

• Identify domain-specific readiness gaps and define targeted enablement strategies to improve execution and results

• Translate capabilities within their specific product, platform, or segment domain, into clear, domain-specific value propositions, use cases, and customer outcomes

• Define how solutions should be positioned across segments, personas, and sales motions

• Ensure messaging reflects the unique needs, challenges, and buying behaviors associated with their specific product, platform, or segment domain

• Establish competitive positioning and differentiation specific to the domain

• Develop domain-specific sales plays, discovery approaches, and deal strategies aligned to their specific product, platform, or segment domain

• Translate product or segment solutions into role-specific execution across SDR, BDR, Account Executives, Partners, and Solution Engineering

• Ensure all sales motions and execution frameworks are tailored to the realities of their specific product, platform, or segment domain, including customer use cases and deal dynamics

• Enable repeatable, scalable execution models that support pipeline generation, deal progression, and expansion within the domain

• Define and own all enablement solutions for their specific product, platform, or segment domain, ensuring they are directly aligned to domain expertise and field execution needs

• Establish requirements and direction for enablement assets specific to their product, platform, or segment domain, including: Sales playbooks, Messaging frameworks, Demo strategies and flows, Competitive positioning guides, Objection handling frameworks, Discovery guides, Deal support materials

• Ensure all assets are built to reflect real-world execution within their specific product, platform, or segment domain, including customer scenarios, industry nuances, and sales motions

• Partner with Content, Learning Design, and Demo Excellence teams to operationalize and deliver these solutions

• Partner with Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Revenue Delivery and Revenue Operations to ensure enablement is aligned to roadmap, messaging, and GTM priorities

• Collaborate with other Enablement Leads to ensure consistency and alignment across product and segment domains

• Ensure horizontal and vertical alignment so that solutions are both globally consistent and locally relevant

• Gather domain-specific field insights, feedback, and performance data related to their specific product, platform, or segment domain

• Identify gaps in positioning, messaging, and execution specific to the domain and drive improvements

• Continuously refine enablement solutions to reflect evolving customer needs, market dynamics, and sales performance

• Ensure enablement remains practical, relevant, and directly tied to field success

What you’ll bring to this role:

• Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent combination of education and work experience

• 5-8 years of experience in sales enablement, product enablement, sales strategy, or a related field

• Experience in B2B technology, SaaS, IoT, or similar industries strongly preferred

• Experience working in cross-functional go-to-market environments required

• Deep expertise in a specific product, platform, solution area, or customer segment, with the ability to translate that knowledge into actionable sales enablement strategies

• Strong understanding of sales enablement principles, value-based and solution selling, and the full revenue lifecycle from prospecting through expansion

• Proven ability to develop domain-specific enablement solutions including sales plays, messaging frameworks, competitive positioning, and execution tools

• Sales methodology certifications (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, CHAMP) considered an asset

• Enablement or product-related certifications considered an asset

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Senior Data Platform Developer who will be building the Geotab internal machine learning and generative AI platform. This role allows all Geotab data scientists and generative AI developers to explore, train, and build machine learning models, gain access to underlying Large Language Models, and build GenAI agent applications for internal services and end customers in production. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you! 

What you'll do:

As a Senior Data Platform Developer, your key area of responsibility will be developing and maintaining new machine learning platforms and managing generative AI applications and agents. You will be responsible for implementing logging, monitoring, and alerting services to ensure the health of Geotab’s AI platform infrastructure, as well as enriching big data with telematics data at scale. You will need to work closely with Geotab’s data scientists and internal teams to understand data processing needs and assist with data integration for newly developed AI platforms. To be successful in this role, you will be a self-starter who is keen to join an industry leader and enjoys working with complex, technical AI concepts.

How you'll make an impact

  • Develop and maintain new machine learning platforms managing the machine learning models and generative AI applications and agents.
  • Develop processes and implement logging, monitoring, and alerting services to ensure the health of Geotab’s AI platform infrastructure.
  • Develop processes to enrich Geotab’s big data with telematics data at scale.
  • Work with data scientists to understand data processing needs and develop infrastructure solutions to support these initiatives.
  • Create and maintain documentation for architecture, requirements, and process flows.
  • Support internal Geotab teams to assist with data integration with newly developed AI platforms.

What you'll bring to the role

  • Post-secondary Degree specialization in Computer Science, Software or Computer Engineering or a related field.
  • 3-5 years experience in a software developer or a similar role. 
  • 3-5 years experience in developing production-level systems using Python 3.
  • 3-5 years experience in developing and maintaining production services in one of the mainstream cloud providers such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • 1-5 years experience in designing, building and maintaining production-level application containerization, such as Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift.
  • Knowledge of fine-tuning and self-hosting vision large language models and generative AI related frameworks (Langgraph, CrewAI, LiteLLM) is a big plus.
  • Experience with OpenSpec, Ralph, Agent Sandbox, and Sourcegraph is highly preferred.
  • Knowledge of AI/ML platforms, such as Ray, VertexAI, Bedrock, and familiarity with Big Data environments (e.g. Google BigQuery).

Geotab is seeking a Senior Deal Desk Manager who will lead commercial deal review and pricing negotiation across Geotab's reseller and direct customer base. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Senior Deal Desk Manager your key area of responsibility will be serving as the primary decision-making authority for non-standard pricing requests, complex reseller RFPs, and commercial agreement structuring. You will need to work closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Legal, and Finance. To be successful in this role you will be a strong team-player, self-motivated leader with an entrepreneurial mindset and excellent communication skills. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities to assess pricing risk, and success in coaching and developing employees.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Provide strategic oversight and decision-making authority for; Non-standard pricing requests across global regions, Complex reseller RFPs requiring custom pricing strategies and Commercial terms proposed in agreements or pricing amendments.
  • Lead commercial negotiations with Sales, Resellers, and direct customers to finalize non-standard pricing agreements, amendments, and deal structures.
  • Manage and prioritize the deal desk queue, ensuring timely review and resolution within defined SLA timelines.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations to ensure deal structures are operationally executable and compliant with established commercial policies.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert and primary escalation point for complex deal scenarios requiring senior-level commercial judgment.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to Deal Desk team members, sharing expertise and best practices to support their professional development.
  • Set clear team priorities on cases, assign work strategically, and ensure timely case resolution.
  • Work with leadership to share performance feedback, support professional development, and identify training opportunities.
  • Support Geotab global strategic initiatives.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 5-8 years experience in a deal desk, commercial pricing, or similar role in a B2B SaaS or technology environment.
  • High level of critical and logical thinking, analysis and/or reasoning to identify underlying principles, reasons, or facts.
  • Strong commercial acumen with demonstrated ability to negotiate pricing and structure complex deals.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess pricing risk and make well-judged decisions.
  • Experience with CPQ or deal management platforms; DealHub experience preferred.
  • Leadership experience in a team-oriented workplace.
  • Strong interpersonal relationship building and negotiation skills.
  • Success with coaching and development of employees.
  • Strong project management skills; able to identify needs, develop effective solutions and manage projects through to completion.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strategic mindset, has a keen sense of priorities, along with an ability to pivot as the landscape changes.
  • A strong team-player with the ability to engage with all levels of the organization.
  • Technical competence using software programs, including, but not limited to, Google Suite for business (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and Excel.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfortable in a flat organization.

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered automation in production environments (portfolio, projects, or practical assessment required).

  • Advanced proficiency using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI) with demonstrated ability to write, review, and orchestrate production-grade code.

What you'll do:

As a Senior Marketing AI & Systems Manager your key area of responsibility will be to design, build, and integrate AI tools directly into our marketing stack to drive growth, personalization, and efficiency. You won't just evaluate AI tools or follow the wave — you will build on it, deploying production-grade systems that help our marketing organization move faster, produce better work, and drive stronger business results.

You will also own the governance, evaluation, and evolution of our marketing technology ecosystem, ensuring that every tool we invest in is connected, optimized, and delivering measurable value. If you are energized by solving complex operational problems with emerging technology, thrive at the crossroads of marketing and engineering, and want to shape how a global organization leverages AI — this role is for you.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Lead the identification and prioritization of AI use cases across the marketing organization, with a focus on efficiency, speed to market, and campaign performance

  • Build multi-step automated systems that eliminate manual effort and accelerate execution — including automated campaign planning, CRM personalization, lifecycle automation, and intelligent briefing workflows

  • Design and deploy AI-powered agents and assistants that transform simple inputs — such as target audience, segment, and campaign goal — into complete channel plans, budgets, content briefs, and activation task lists

  • Connect AI systems to Geotab's sources of truth, including brand guidelines, product documentation, case studies, campaign performance data, and our CRM and marketing automation platforms, to ensure all outputs are accurate, on-brand, and strategically aligned

  • Implement governance frameworks including citation tracking, tone validation, PII redaction, and human-in-the-loop review steps to ensure AI outputs meet our quality and compliance standards

  • Monitor AI system performance across usage metrics, output quality, cost efficiency, and adoption rates; continuously iterate to improve reliability and value delivery

  • Prototype and implement LLM-powered tools that support rapid content generation, A/B testing, and the creation of campaign and landing page variants at scale

  • Develop and maintain machine learning approaches to forecast marketing trends, predict customer behavior, and surface insights that inform campaign strategy and budget allocation

  • Rapidly prototype AI solutions and transition them into stable, scalable production environments — balancing speed of experimentation with engineering rigor

  • Ensure all AI systems meet enterprise standards for data privacy, security, and governance throughout the full development lifecycle

  • Own the marketing technology stack strategy and roadmap, with responsibility for evaluating, onboarding, integrating, and optimizing martech tools across the organization

  • Build and maintain robust integrations between platforms including CMS, DAM, marketing automation (Marketo), CRM (Salesforce), analytics (GA4/BI), project management (Jira), and collaboration tools (Slack/Teams) to enable unified data activation and workflow efficiency

  • Partner with third-party data providers such as Clay, ZoomInfo, and 6sense to enrich lead and account data, improving audience targeting and segmentation capabilities across campaigns

  • Ensure data flows cleanly and reliably between systems, maintaining data integrity and enabling accurate measurement across the full marketing funnel

  • Act as the central bridge between technical AI capabilities and marketing strategy — translating complex engineering concepts into actionable approaches for marketing stakeholders, and translating marketing requirements into precise technical specifications

  • Act as a central resource and subject matter expert for campaign and segment marketers, enabling them to leverage AI tools and workflows effectively in their day-to-day work

  • Partner with the Senior Marketing Automation Manager(s) to align AI initiatives with marketing automation strategy, ensuring cohesive execution across the Marketing Operations team

  • Collaborate closely with the Digital Marketing team on AI-driven content discoverability initiatives — including how Geotab content surfaces and is cited within AI-generated search environments such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews

  • Partner with Analytics and BI stakeholders to develop reporting frameworks and campaign performance insights that demonstrate the business impact of AI-driven initiatives

  • Collaborate with IT, Legal, Security, and Data teams to ensure all AI systems and integrations meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, and compliance

  • Champion a culture of experimentation and continuous learning within the marketing organization, driving adoption of AI tools through training, documentation, and hands-on support

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 7+ years of experience in marketing operations, marketing technology, or a closely related field, with a strong emphasis on building and shipping AI, automation, or advanced analytics solutions in a B2B marketing environment

  • Proven track record of building and deploying AI-powered tools or workflows in a production marketing context — not just evaluating or recommending them

  • Strong understanding of the B2B marketing funnel, demand generation principles, and how marketing technology drives pipeline growth

  • Experience managing and integrating complex martech stacks, with hands-on knowledge of platforms such as Marketo, Salesforce, GA4, and content management systems

  • Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript for building and maintaining AI applications, agents, and integrations

  • Deep knowledge of context engineering and working with LLM APIs — including OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or equivalent models — to build reliable, production-grade AI systems

  • Familiarity with AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)

  • Experience working with vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate) and designing knowledge retrieval systems

  • Hands-on experience with integration platforms and workflow automation tools (e.g., Workato, Make, Zapier)

  • Comfort with front-end basics (HTML/CSS) for lightweight UI development and tooling presentation layers

  • Understanding of enterprise security practices including OAuth, SSO, and cloud deployment standards

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable marketing insights and clearly communicate the business impact of technical work to revenue and marketing stakeholders

  • Excellent communication skills — equally comfortable explaining AI architecture to an engineer and presenting workflow improvements to a CMO

  • Experience with third-party B2B data enrichment platforms (e.g., Clay, ZoomInfo, 6sense) and intent data strategies

  • Familiarity with AI search optimization, answer engine optimization (AEO), and how brands can build authority and citation presence in AI-driven discovery environments

  • Prepare and present to leadership quarterly and annual reports on forecasts, sales performance, market trends, and the status of Partner relationships

  • Provide design documents and documentation to ensure efficient maintenance and code reuse.
  • Provide recommendations for improvements in the overall development process.

  • 2+ years of experience in software development, system design, and architecture.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Strategic Communications Specialist who will execute Geotab's communications strategy by developing and implementing impactful communication initiatives that build the company's reputation, drive media engagement, and advance business objectives. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Strategic Communications Specialist, your key area of responsibility will be executing communications strategies across media relations, content creation, and measurement to support Geotab's thought leadership and brand awareness goals. You will be responsible for managing media reporting programs, coordinating campaigns and media briefings, and building meaningful relationships with journalists and external stakeholders. You will also need to work closely with Geotab's Marketing team, senior leaders, and external media partners to ensure consistent and impactful storytelling.

To be successful in this role you will be a naturally curious, outgoing, and confident communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with journalists, executives, and partners. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong organizational skills, hands-on experience with media monitoring and measurement tools, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while staying current on emerging communications trends and best practices.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Develop and execute communication initiatives that deliver impactful messaging to a diverse audience and advance Geotab's business growth objectives.
  • Create content and storytelling strategy to support Geotab's overall media and thought leadership strategy, including media releases, social media, presentations and background research/data analysis.
  • Manage the Geotab reporting program including media metrics, wire distribution, insights, and dashboards (CISION, Meltwater, Google Analytics, and others).
  • Coordinate and own the strategy and logistics of campaigns, announcements, media briefings, press interactions and presence at strategic industry events.
  • Build and manage relationships with journalists and external stakeholders to build reputation and create ongoing opportunities to tell Geotab's business story.
  • Monitor and evaluate evolving media trends, tools, and technologies (including AI-driven solutions) and recommend improvements to elevate communications practices and impact.
  • Conduct ongoing competitive analysis and benchmarking to inform strategic communications and social media strategy.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 3-5 years of experience in corporate communications, technology communications, and/or agency experience.
  • Proven experience in media relations, including building and managing networks of journalists, trade reporters, and social media influencers, with a focus on North America.
  • Hands-on experience with media measurement and monitoring tools such as CISION, Meltwater, Google Analytics, and AI-driven solutions.
  • Exceptional writing skills with the ability to create compelling content across multiple formats including media releases, social media, and presentations.
  • Experience with strategic planning, annual plan development, and reporting on media and social media performance metrics.
  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field; a postgraduate diploma in Communications or PR is considered a strong asset. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
  • Confident, polished communicator with the ability to represent Geotab with journalists, executives, partners, and at industry events.

Geotab is seeking a Software Development Team Lead, Altitude who will lead a small cross-functional team — including engineers and UX — building Altitude by Geotab's transportation intelligence platform. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Software Development Team Lead, Altitude your key area of responsibility will be combining hands-on technical leadership with people management, driving the design and delivery of scalable, data-driven products that serve public and private sector customers. You will need to work closely with product managers, data scientists, and direct-report UX designers to define, design, and ship features across the Altitude platform.

To be successful in this role you will be a strong team-player with an entrepreneurial mindset, strong analytical skills, and a bias toward shipping value in small, validated increments. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong project management skills, strong engineering depth, and experience leveraging an AI-first mindset across end-to-end development workflows.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Direct software development projects; develop and implement efficient, clean code with assigned team that satisfies customer requirements. All accomplished with an AI first mindset. Not only to write the code but for end to end development.

  • Manage team with regards to task assignments, work arrangements and other Software Development Department expectations.

  • Ensure work progress stays on schedule and update stakeholders on project status.

  • Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and a direct-report UX designers to define, design, and ship features across the Altitude platform.

  • Perform Test-Driven and Security-Driven Development.

  • Conduct comprehensive testing and code reviews to ensure that code quality is maximized and best-practices are followed.

  • Participate in development of prototypes, minimum viable products and PoCs.

  • Appropriately document system design and architecture such that it is easy to understand, maintain and extend.

  • Provide expert project-leadership and guidance to the team as a SME.

  • Oversee the activities and performance of direct reports: provide direction, coaching and mentorship; engage in team development, feedback, and training opportunities; collaborate during performance management, meeting KPAs, and career development planning.

  • Support Geotab global strategic initiatives and participate in a 24x7 on-call rotating schedule (if applicable).

  • Consistently demonstrate Geotab’s Core Values in all daily work and interactions, and contribute to/maintain the departmental Wiki.

What you'll bring to this role:

  • Post-Secondary Diploma/Degree specialization in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • 4+ years experience as a Software Developer using object-oriented programming to build scalable applications.

  • Leadership experience in a team-oriented workplace, including success with coaching, development, and performance management of direct reports.

  • Experience managing or providing direction to a UX designer or design function, including reviewing prototypes and giving meaningful design feedback.

  • Technical proficiency with Google BigQuery, cloud-native data pipelines (GCP preferred), Docker, Kubernetes, and messaging queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

  • Hands-on experience across full-stack technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Storybook, Node.js, Go, Python) and distributed source control tools (Git).

  • Proven experience leveraging AI to write code, optimize workflows, and streamline development processes.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills with high accuracy and meticulous attention to detail.

  • Coordinate with internal departments on the return/exchange process for Geotab devices and accessories.
  • Diagnose and resolve technical hardware and software issues involving connectivity, installation and software inquiries.
  • Manage, develop and deliver product service training directly to resellers and customers.
  • Provide successful resolution to all customer complaints.
  • Report escalating and severe concerns/issues to management.
  • Preserve the confidentiality and security of customer data and information.
  • Support Geotab global strategic initiatives.

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 1-3 years of experience in customer service/support capacity troubleshooting technical issues.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Italian and English.
  • Expert level Excel skills, including creation of pivot tables and reports.
  • Experience working within a technical or engineering organization/knowledge of the high-technology industry is an asset.
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Comfort speaking with customers by telephone, email and chat.
  • Must stay relevant to technology and should have the flexibility to adapt to the growing technology and market demands.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to problem solve well-judged decisions.
  • A strong team-player with the ability to engage with all levels of the organization.

title: Account Manager- DC
description:
PagerDuty (NYSE:PD) is a leader in Digital Operations Management. In an always-on world, organizations of all sizes trust PagerDuty to help them deliver a perfect digital experience to their customers, every time. Teams use PagerDuty to identify issues and opportunities in real time and bring together the right people to fix problems faster and prevent them in the future. Over 13,000 organizations (including 60 of Fortune 100) rely on PagerDuty to succeed with Digital Transformation, Cloud Migration, and DevOps Modernization. Notable customers include GE, Cisco, Genentech, Electronic Arts, Cox Automotive, Netflix, Shopify, Zoom, DoorDash, Lululemon and more. We are expanding rapidly as a platform for Digital Operations Management using AI/ML and Automation and growing our adoption by Development, IT, Customer Service, Security, and other teams across the organization.

PagerDuty is seeking an Account Manager to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As an Account Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of existing SaaS customers, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. You will maintain and grow customer relationships, drive product adoption, manage renewals, and identify strategic expansion opportunities that deliver measurable business value. This is an exciting opportunity to blend customer success and sales expertise to help customers realize the full potential of PagerDuty’s platform while driving revenue growth.

The ideal candidate is a proactive relationship builder with strong commercial acumen, a passion for data-driven customer management, and experience with SaaS products and AI-driven insights.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own a portfolio of existing customers to ensure adoption, value realization, and retention.
  • Develop and execute account plans that drive renewals, mitigate churn risk, and uncover expansion opportunities.
  • Present and negotiate renewal proposals, structure multi-year options, and manage contract value through strategic account management.
  • Monitor customer health using usage analytics, telemetry, and business insights to identify and address risks early.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Sales Operations, and Renewals teams to ensure smooth contracting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
  • Maintain strong product knowledge and deliver consultative guidance to drive configuration optimization and feature adoption.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of combined customer-facing experience, including Account Management, Customer Success, or Renewals.
  • 4+ years of proven success managing renewals and growth within a SaaS environment.
  • Experience using Salesforce (SFDC) and analytics tools such as Gainsight, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data analytics and health metrics to manage and retain customer accounts.
  • Prior enterprise sales expertise leveraging MEDDPICC & Value Selling.
  • Experience working with enterprise software customers or in a DevOps environment.
  • Strong understanding of AI-powered tools and how they can be leveraged to drive efficiency and insight.
  • Proven history of achieving revenue and retention goals through consultative account management.
  • Self-starter with strong collaboration, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

The base salary range for this position is $105,000.00 - $125,400.00 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.

Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.

Hesitant to apply?

We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts!

Where we work

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

Location restrictions:
Australia: Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia
Canada: Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon
United States: Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming
Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.

How we work

Our values guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.

People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.

What we offer

As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our benefits site.

Your package may include:

  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive benefits package 
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Company equity*
  • ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*
  • Retirement or pension plan*
  • Generous paid vacation time
  • Paid holidays and sick leave
  • Dutonian Wellness Days & HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO
  • Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*
  • Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year
  • Company-wide hack weeks
  • Mental wellness programs

*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure

About PagerDuty

PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses

PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2. 

Go behind-the-scenes on our careers site and @pagerduty on Instagram.

Additional Information

PagerDuty is an equal opportunity employer. PagerDuty does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status. Your privacy is important to us. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read and understand PagerDuty's Privacy Policy.

PagerDuty is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. Should you require accommodation, please email accommodation@pagerduty.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

PagerDuty uses the E-Verify employment verification program.

description:

About the role

PagerDuty’s Operations Cloud runs on a platform that ingests billions of signals and turns them into real-time action for thousands of customers. We’re looking for an early-career AI/ML Engineer who is excited to grow at the intersection of two disciplines: large-scale distributed systems and machine learning.

In this role you will help build and ship AI systems that run in production at PagerDuty’s scale — powering Incident Management AI Agents, event intelligence, and the LLM-powered capabilities embedded across our platform. You’ll work alongside senior engineers on real production problems, learning how AI features go from a prototype to something that serves reliably at scale.

We are looking for a candidate who is genuinely excited about building with modern AI — LLMs, agents, and retrieval — eager to learn how resilient, high-throughput systems are built, and motivated to grow into an engineer who is strong in both.

What you’ll do

  • Contribute to AI-powered features — LLM agents, retrieval, and event intelligence — that operate on high-volume, real-time data, with support and guidance from senior engineers.
  • Help build and maintain the systems behind them — prompt and agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, tool/API integrations, and inference services — writing code, adding tests, and improving observability.
  • Learn to reason about latency, throughput, cost, and reliability of LLM-powered services, and apply those lessons in the code you write.
  • Help take AI features from prototype toward production, and support the evaluation and monitoring loops that keep them accurate and trustworthy over time.
  • Partner with platform, product, and applied-research teams, asking good questions and turning requirements into working code.
  • Grow through code review, pairing, and mentorship, and steadily take on more ownership as you develop.

What you’ll bring

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production software.
  • Degree in CS/a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Solid programming fundamentals and comfort moving between application code and AI/model code.
  • Hands-on experience with modern AI — building something real with LLMs, prompting, retrieval, or agent frameworks.
  • Some exposure to distributed systems and how software runs reliably at scale, and eagerness to deepen it.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to have

  • Personal, academic, or internship projects involving LLM apps, agents, RAG, or backend services.
  • Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containers, or Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with the ecosystem — e.g. LLM APIs and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, vector databases, and orchestration/streaming tools like Kafka or Airflow.
  • Interest in agentic systems, evaluation and guardrails for LLMs, or applied problems like anomaly detection and event correlation.
  • Contributions to open-source projects.

Why PagerDuty

At PagerDuty, AI it’s core to how we help the world’s teams keep their digital services running. This is a place to start your career on problems where scale, latency, and correctness genuinely matter, surrounded by engineers who will invest in helping you grow and who build systems that people depend on in their most critical moments.
